title: The Cross and Bones
overview: Welcome to Drumheller, Alberta: a small town smack dab in the middle of the Canadian Badlands where Jesus Christ, Tyrannosaurus Rex and 3000 bikers collide in steaming irony. Juxtaposing a summer production of The Passion Play, the world’s richest dinosaur graveyard and an annual Harley rally, THE CROSS AND BONES is an ironic exploration of this town through the eyes of locals and tourists who flock to this mythical landscape, to either worship a theatrical God, dig for giant skeletons or party hardy.
